title: Chica Maga Medieval en Pintura al Óleo Realista con Fondo de Boceto en Borrador

The girl has long hair, fair skin, and a calm yet determined expression. The overall presentation uses an impasto painting technique, with visible brushstrokes full of artistic tension. The background is a canvas of structural sketch drafts and human-proportion line drawings, featuring red pencil quick sketches, mage-pose studies, grid lines, and other elements, showing a composition where the rough draft and finished work overlap. High resolution, rich texture, natural light, a combination of realism and artistic style, with delicate details.
